title: Minimize Result by Adding Parentheses to Expression
goal: Place one pair of parentheses around the plus sign to minimize the expression value.
strategy: Enumerate every left cut before the plus and right cut after it. Missing outside factors equal one; evaluate the two outside factors times the enclosed sum and retain the smallest result.
